_comment: The meets the seeded roster competes in, and the ONE place they are named.
Committed and hand-maintained, read by both stacks: Server/scripts/createCompetitions.js
creates them, and Web/e2e/support/meets.js resolves a place to its level so a
seeding run can pick the right level on the post-login chooser. Before this
file the places lived in createCompetitions.js and the place-to-level map was
copied into the e2e helpers by hand, where drift did not fail loudly: picking
the level a meet is NOT at simply finds no competitions, and the run dies on
'Nothing at X Level', which reads like missing seed data rather than a stale map.
Twenty meets over all six levels, laddered through the season so district runs
first and DSO last: three each at district, state, national and international, four
each at university and DSO (added 2026-10-24 for the lifecycle check). The year field
stays 2026 for the 2027 dates because a meet is the SEASON's, and the season slide
moves every date anyway. Dates are Saturdays, verified rather than
assumed; each meet ends the following day. The competition status rules key off
these -- 'ongoing' is refused before the start date, and a started meet cannot be
deleted -- so they sit far enough out to keep every meet in 'upcoming'.
Places must stay distinct: a meet is identified by name + place + year, so two
meets sharing a place would be the same competition.
name: Bhausaheb Ranade Navodit
